clarification.en: PLI is a specific financial incentive mechanism, whereas Make in India is a comprehensive national program to improve the industrial ecosystem.

relationship.en: Industrial corridors provide the physical infrastructure, while PLI provides the financial impetus for manufacturing within those zones.
